title: EarthAlign: Learning Language-Aligned Representations of Earth System Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.14624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interpreting Earth system conditions is central to understanding environmental risks and informing decisions across weather- and climate-sensitive sectors. Existing multimodal weather systems primarily target task-specific prediction, generation, or question answering, while general-purpose alignment between Earth system data and language remains underexplored due to the limited availability of diverse language supervision grounded in meteorological conditions. To fill this gap, we introduce EarthAlign, a large-scale dataset with broad geographic coverage spanning 2000-2024 that combines 10 expert-curated natural event and disaster data sources with climatology-derived normal-weather samples. Each sample includes temporal and geospatial information and four grounded caption styles aligned with 63-variable ERA5 meteorological data. translated_title: EarthAlign：学习地球系统数据的语言对齐表示
translated_abstract: 解读地球系统状况对于理解环境风险以及为天气和气候敏感行业提供决策支持至关重要。现有的多模态天气系统主要针对特定任务的预测、生成或问答，而地球系统数据与语言之间的通用对齐由于基于气象条件的多样化语言监督数据的可用性有限，仍然研究不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了EarthAlign，这是一个大规模数据集，覆盖2000至2024年的广泛地理范围，结合了10个专家整理的自然事件和灾害数据源与由气候学导出的正常天气样本。每个样本包含时间和地理空间信息，以及与63变量ERA5气象数据对齐的四种接地描述风格。基于EarthAlign，我们进一步提出了MeteoLIP，一个用于学习气象数据与语言对齐表示的双编码器框架。
tldr: 本文提出了大规模气象-语言对齐数据集EarthAlign（覆盖2000-2024年、结合灾害事件与正常天气样本）以及双编码器框架MeteoLIP，首次实现了地球系统数据与自然语言之间的通用对齐表示学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EarthAlign, a large-scale dataset combining expert-curated disaster events with normal-weather samples spanning 2000-2024, and MeteoLIP, a dual-encoder framework, to enable general-purpose language-aligned representation learning for Earth system data.
